items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Tyree Glenn had a band upstairs.

ctx.x: I stayed over there -- I went over there, and I stayed at the Metropole until the time to go with Buck to Europe, and when I came back from there, I went with Cootie Williams in the club that Birdland owned over there on the East Side. And we stayed over there for until about six or eight weeks. Do you remember that club? Tyree Glenn had a band upstairs.
: What was that called, the Round House?
